claim.notes: CFR+ with linear averaging, 60000 iterations, solver/solve.py. Exploitability computed by exact best responses over the tree (assumes perfect recall, not separately verified). Exploitability decreased steadily (1.2e-3 at 20k, 6.95e-4 at 60k) but slowly, roughly 1/t, so the strategy is approximate; more iterations would tighten it further. Value for player 0 is about 0.5300 (best-response values 0.5305 and 0.5291).
